text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, Mejiro 
Ardan spoke up rather hesitantly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. If you have some time, 
would you like to take a little detour 
with me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You'll have to wait until we get there to 
find out... Heheh. I might not look it, 
but I'm quite the expert at taking 
detours, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ever since coming to the academy, I have 
frequently indulged in taking detours 
after class, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... The place we're heading to next is 
sure to be enjoyable.

—And the place we arrived at was a famous 
aquarium a bit further out. I'd heard 
rumors about it, but had never actually 
visited until now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
See? Isn't it beautiful? The colorful sea 
creatures, the massive tanks, the 
underwater tunnel—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Truth be told, I hadn't been here 
until just recently either. I stumbled 
upon it by chance while taking a detour.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Wandering off on a whim, only to stumble 
upon something wonderfully unexpected—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"You never know until you walk it like 
that. I believe that is the true joy of 
taking a detour."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
There are still plenty of areas I would 
like to show you. Now, please follow me.

She seemed to be pulling me along with 
unusual assertiveness. Finding it somewhat 
endearing, I walked through the building 
with her—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The next segment is... Oh?

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text: Ugh... They're not here~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"My. There's supposed to be a family of 
killer whales here, but..."

"It's a pretty huge aquarium, but she's 
certainly nowhere to be seen. ...Could she 
have gone all the way to the back, I 
wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
Guess we can't see the orcas today... What 
a bummer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. Trainer-san, please watch closely, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Kyuii~

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text: !? An orca!? Where!? Where!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Now then, where could it be♪ 
—Squeak, squeak♪

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh!? Don't tell me Big Sis was 
copying me? That's amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... When I was a child, I watched a 
nature documentary on the hospital room TV 
about animal calls.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
There was a time when I secretly 
practiced, thinking that if I worked hard 
enough, maybe I'd eventually be able to 
talk with animals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Honestly speaking, it's a bit of 
an embarrassing memory.

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text: "...Ah!? An orca came! An orca!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Orca Calf
text_block_list.text: Kyui~...?

Perhaps reacting to Mejiro Ardan's 
voice... Before we knew it, the family of 
killer whales was casting curious glances 
at us through the aquarium glass.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My, don't tell me, really...? I am truly 
astonished.

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, incredible...! Big sis, you 
can really talk to orcas...! Hey, teach me 
too! Teach me orca language!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, with pleasure. Let's see, the trick 
to producing sound first is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—That was a wonderful surprise. I wonder 
what my voice sounded like to them, what 
words they heard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To think a wish from my childhood would 
come true now of all times... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's a little embarrassing, but... fufu, 
thank you♪
choice_data_list: I want to hear it one more time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Right here? Well, no, I mean—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. I suppose it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Kyuiii~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, isn't that right? Isn't it fun?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Thank goodness. It really is a wonderful 
feeling, being able to share the lovely 
things you know with other people.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It would be lovely if we could 
find many wonderful places together.
